data.name: ResourceUidInvalid
data.value: A resource uid is a non-empty version 7 UUID that the ResourceManager assigns at create.

data.name: ResourceIdInvalid
data.value: A resource id is an address of the form /environments/{env}[/groups/{group}|/applications/{app}[/providers/{Namespace}/{type}/{name}]|/operations/{operation}], with lowercase names.

data.name: ResourceNameInvalid
data.value: A resource name is 1 to 63 lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens per dot-separated segment, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen.

data.name: ResourceTypeNameInvalid
data.value: A resource type name is {Namespace}/{type}: dot-separated PascalCase namespace segments, a slash, and a camelCase type, such as Cohesion.Workloads/workloads.

data.name: PlatformNameInvalid
data.value: A platform name is 1 to 63 lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, starting with a letter, such as kubernetes.

data.name: ApiVersionInvalid
data.value: An API version is a calendar date in the form yyyy-MM-dd, optionally followed by -preview.

data.name: FabricValueAmbiguous
data.value: A fabric value holds either a literal or a $ref, never both and never neither.

data.name: FabricRefShapeInvalid
data.value: A $ref object has a string '$ref' member, an optional string 'path' member, and no other members.

data.name: PlatformResourceTypeDuplicate

data.name: PlatformExtensionDuplicate

data.name: PlatformExtensionForeign

data.name: PlatformDefaultName

data.name: PlatformDefaultContractVersion
